subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private/VPC deployment - networking & data residency
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@acmehealth.com>, Laura Simms <laura.simms@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private/VPC deployment - networking & data residency

Hi James / Laura —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a shared source of truth. If I missed anything, tell me and I’ll update.

Key pain points and drivers
- Regulatory/data residency: all inference processing and model host must remain within AcmeHealth-controlled VPCs or on-prem clusters for PHI compliance.
- Egress restrictions: inference hosts cannot initiate outbound internet traffic; only specific management IPs allowed for upgrades/monitoring when explicitly approved.
- Air-gap possibility: a subset of workloads may require an air-gapped deployment or tightly controlled jump host for model sync.

Goals we heard
- Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with customer-managed networking and KMS/HSM integration for key material.
- Ability to run Redwood Private control plane in Acme's VPC (or on-prem appliance) and keep inference data within Acme's network.
- Minimal service-level footprint for telemetry — only necessary health/metrics to allowed endpoints.

Technical constraints called out on the call
- No broad outbound access from inference cluster; allowlist-only egress to our management/control-plane IPs (we discussed using a dedicated VPN or peering).
- Firewall rules: CIDR ranges and ports will be provided by Acme infra team; we will share a recommended minimal set.
- KMS/HSM: need details on provider (AWS KMS, Thales, etc.) and whether HSM is reachable from VPC or only on-prem.

Next steps / Who's doing what
- Marissa (me): share our proposed network diagram and minimal firewall rules (attached: network-diagram.png, redwood-minimum-reqs.pdf) — by EOD tomorrow.
- Acme: share your VPC topology and any existing egress block rules (James / IT) — ideally before our infra handoff.
- Rishi (cc'd): will take the lead on the security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence requests.
- Schedule a technical handoff with Acme infra + Redwood infra (30–45m). Proposed slots: Mon 11/29 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 11/30 14:00–15:00 PT.

Attachments referenced: network-diagram.png (high-level), redwood-minimum-reqs.pdf (ports, CIDRs, prerequisites).

Thanks again — excited to help you get this live with minimal friction.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Timeline: we’re targeting a Q1 2027 pilot (internal approvals + procurement).

- Firewall rules: I attached our current high-level requirements (acme_vpc_requirements.xlsx) — it lists our management jump hosts and approved outbound endpoints.
